node.doctext:
Thank you, esteemed brother!

  3. Fixed. I have renamed all the sections of [The Monastery Gates] to remove the word "New", since that's not really what the Front Page is about (anymore?). I also renamed the SoPW section as "Supplications". If people have heartburn with that, let me know. Maybe I'll change it back. :-)
I reckon we are the only monastery ever to have a dungeon stuffed with 16[523120|,]000 zombies.
